Another player

attrs.note: the simulation, acting on its own

nodes.name: The server

attrs.story: You pick one of four modes from the menu, appear near the space station that is your base, and the ship answers the mouse or the keyboard. Nothing else can happen until it does.

nodes.name: Choose a mode and reach the field

attrs.story: You shoot asteroids and the crystals they drop are worth something. Bigger rocks pay more per shot and cost more to stay near. The cargo has a ceiling, and gems that would exceed it are simply lost.

nodes.name: Mine the belt and fill the cargo

attrs.story: A full cargo can go into eight statistics, into an extra life, or into the next ship in the tree — and taking the next ship hands you an un-upgraded one. That is the decision the whole loop exists for.

nodes.name: Spend the cargo, or trade up a tier

attrs.story: Shields absorb until they do not, and past that every hit knocks crystals out of your hold for anyone to take. Dying puts you back in a tier one ship with nothing.

nodes.name: Fight, bleed gems, and die back to tier one

attrs.story: A repulsive field grows out from the star and pushes everyone inward, warning as it goes. The round ends when one player remains.

nodes.name: The field closes and one player is left

answers.text: game mode; objective
